name: Sara Lee All Butter Pound Cake (Thawed Slice)
whyItWorks: Sara Lee pound cake is famous for its dense, ultra-fine, velvety crumb that dissolves into a creamy paste with gentle chewing. It has no rough crust, nuts, or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Thaw a slice from the freezer. Delicious plain or topped with sliced ripe bananas and maple syrup.
watchOuts: Contains dairy butter and whole milk; take lactase if severely lactose sensitive.
